file: assets/walk/{d,p}/coarse.bin (every 16th frame), chunk-00.bin to chunk-14.bin (the other frames, 32 in a row), poster.webp (frame 0)
notes: Built by scripts/walk-frames.sh: five clips sampled at 10 to 12 frames per second of real motion, joined with 0.4 s crossfades, graded (70% colour under a 45% green-to-ivory duotone, edge darkening).
d: 1280×720 for landscape screens; p: 540×960 portrait crops for phones.
